title: Little signs they're in love with you

slides.title: Little signs they’re *in love with you*
They text you *when they get home*
They send you things that *remind them of you*
slides.body: A song, a meme, a dog that looks like you.

slides.title: They notice when *you go quiet*
slides.body: And ask about it gently, later.

slides.title: You’re in their plans *without thinking*
slides.body: “We should go there” is always a we.

slides.title: They introduce you to *the people who matter*
slides.body: Friends, family, the barista they love.

slides.title: They get excited about *your small news*
slides.body: The good email gets a full celebration.
